qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive store network (B&Q, Castorama, Screwfix) and own-brand sourcing provide retail purchasing scale, but 5-year median GAAP ROIC is deeply sub-hurdle at ~5-7% (far below the 12% threshold). Big-box DIY retail suffers from intense price competition, heavy lease liabilities, and lack of customer lock-in.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Kingfisher operates home improvement retail across the UK, France, and Poland, but generates structurally weak capital returns with multi-year ROIC hovering at only 5-7% and thin 3.5-6.5% operating margins. Highly exposed to cyclical housing turnover and consumer DIY pullbacks, it lacks genuine pricing power against discounters and online rivals.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-banner home improvement retailer with >2,000 stores across 8 European countries generating ~£13B in revenue. Group operating margins fluctuate between 3.5% and 6.5%. ROIC consistently prints in the 5-7% range, trailing its ~8% cost of capital. Substantial operating lease obligations and heavy store overhead prevent high-return capital compounding.
